newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan tenders to buy up to 7,000/T of May MTBE.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan tenders to buy up to 7,000/T of May MTBE.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy 3,500 to 7,000 tonnes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) for May 6-20 delivery to Kaohsiung and Keelung, a company official said on Tuesday.
The tender closes March 31 and is valid until April 2.
In its last MTBE tender, CPC bought 7,000 tonnes for April 6-20 delivery from Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC) at $280-$283 per tonne cost-and-freight Kaohsiung and Keelung.
MTBE is an additive to boost the octane level of gasoline.
